notes.title: August 3, 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/c3cd45222b7a70e1b01765d9fd4502c89b4d2c8b.jpg[/img]

Greetings C9 Actionist!

Server Maintenance has concluded and the game servers are now live! We appreciate everyone's kind patience and understanding. Below are some of the changes that have been done in the game.

[b][General][/b]

• Server Refresh

• Optimization and adjustment
1. Add (Spinning Alphabet Lock] anti-hanger system
2.Ensilrot - Withered Eternal Forest-Otherworld [Expert Difficulty] - Minion EXP removal in the Boss room
3.Taoist- Guardian: Adept Taoist>[Mana Blast][Circle Commnion][Velvet Mirrorj skill issue got fixed
4. Illusionist- Guardian: Adept llusionst>Mindflash] skill issue got fixed
5. Taoist - Guardian: Adept Taoist> (Circle Commnion][Velvet Mirrorj skill level increase has been changed to [Soul Burn]lVelvet Crasher level increase
6. Event Treasure Trove Link will be removed
7. In the character information screen, fix the issue that the Gold Carriage button on the right
side of the Royal Ticket could not be opened

[b][Event][/b]

• Goddess of Malevolence Day
300% EXP Bonus!
Duration: July 14, 2023 to July 16, 2023


[b][Class optimization][/b]

Warrior (Destroyer)
Seismic Bash: damage factor will increase significantly

Guardian (Royal Guard)
Titan's Guardian: Redo the skill book Lessons in Defense, by Depen in centum: Titan's Guardian; Shockwave attack damage factor increased significantly; cooldown reduced to 30seconds
Punishing Uppercut: Add the attack combos; Ater Level 20, Damage Rate increases significantly
Titan Crash: Add the attack combos
Earthquake: Add the attack combos
Double Combination: Add the attack combos
Shield Smash: After Level 18, the Damage Rate increases significantly
Shield Reflection: After Level 10, the Damage Rate increases significantly
Charge Attack: After Level 20, Damage Rate increases significantly
Breakneck Charge: After Level 12, Damage Rate increases significantly

    Skill book Set Stats Modification
    Lessons in Defense, by Depen incentum Set Stats IV Set effects, will be modified as follows
    - Before: When using the Titan's Guardian, 25% chance to reduce enemies' physical defense by 30% for 15 seconds
    - After: When using the Tian's Guardian, 100% chance to reduce enemies' physical defense by 30% for 15 seconds
    Lessons in Defense, by Depen Incentum Set Stats V Set effects, will be modified as follows
    - Before: When using the lron Skin, 30% chance to increase your own strength by 600 for 3 seconds
    - After: When using the lronheart, 100% chance to increase your own strength by 600 for 50seconds

[b][Cash Shop Sale][/b]

• Adept Myst Random Chest II
• Sealed Nepahi Rune Chest[STR]
• Sealed Nepahi Rune Chest[WIS]
• Mana Extract Rift Stone Box

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/ee60c0daa26cbd9310c3bfdec8b47b70ee2e1392.png[/img]

Greetings C9 Actionist!

Server Maintenance has concluded and the game servers are now live! We appreciate everyone's kind patience and understanding. Below are some of the changes that have been done in the game.

[b][General][/b]

• Server Refresh

[b][Class Optimization][/b]

[b]SCOUT[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/bbeb2f89afcb7d0c4c26f92d755666013d7c16d5.png[/img]

[b]Fire support: [/b]The cooling time is reduced to 30 seconds;
Redo skill book of How to Travel Incognito, by Pillus Garon: Fire Support.
Explosive Trap: More traps can be summoned according to the higher level, up to 4 traps can be summoned at cap level.

[b]Freezing Trap: [/b]More traps can be summoned according to the higher level, up to 4 traps can be summoned at cap level
Spinning Turret: Increasing the duration of the summons to 15 seconds;
More traps can be summoned according to the higher level, up to 3 traps can be summoned at cap level.

[b]Line Turret:[/b] Increasing the duration of the summons to 18 seconds;
More traps can be summoned according to the higher level, up to 3 traps can be summoned at cap level

[b]Flame Trap: [/b]The cooling time is reduced to 20 seconds;
Increasing the duration of the summons to 20 seconds;
More traps can be summoned according to the higher level up to 3 traps can be summoned at cap level.

[b]Lethargic Mist: [/b]The cooling time is reduced to 20 seconds
Blast Ring: Casting skills that inflict physical damage are modified to inflict magical damage;
Add more combos to Perfect Rare Skill Book Traps and Gambits, by Pines Dinal: Blast Ring
Grind: Improve the effect of magic attack power, and cooldown time reduced to 60 seconds.

PS. After this change, summoning multiple traps will visually overlap together but it actually summons multiple traps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/0c1ebd5ad2134a82fa995c8fa0b6f2b1518a8626.png[/img]

[b]New Feature[/b]

[b]Weapon/armor/jewelry magic power extraction and enchanting[/b]

1. After using [Weapon Magic Power Extraction Rift Stone [Fine]], you can extract magic power from the equipment that has been enchanted with magic power, and after successful extraction, you can get [Transcendent Weapon Ore [N Star]] and [Equipment after being extracted with magic power).

2. After using [Transcendent Weapon Ore [6 Star]], you can enchant the current unenhanced
magic or low-level magic equipment with magic power, and after successful enchanting, you can obtain [6-star magic level gear]

Friendly reminder:

1. The current [Magic power Extraction] and [Transcendent Ore] are only valid for weapons
armors/jewelry within Lv.80~89 and Lv.90~95, and cannot be used by other levels.

2. Current weapon ore which0 was extracted from Lv.80 weapons, is only valid for weapons within the range of level 80~89, and the same for armors/jewelry, but not for other levels

nor jewelry.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/0131d1011735bd6cf0732694a79a687ae7b6d2e2.png[/img]

Greetings C9 Actionist!

Server Maintenance has concluded and the game servers are now live! We appreciate everyone's kind patience and understanding. Below are some of the changes that have been done in the game.

[b][General][/b]

• Server Refresh

• Adjustment: Class Balance Optimization

[b]A. Blade dancer/Flower dance Elf[/b]

[b]Flora: [/b]Skill cooldown decreased from 9 seconds to 6 seconds， added buff: self-damage decreased by 30% for 6 seconds； at the same time, the effect of the skill book [Twice the Swords for Twice the Fun, by Sha Nyweide: Flora]will be changed to Overlord， for 2 seconds/3 seconds/4 seconds/5 seconds respectively
[b]
Violet Cross: [/b]Skill cooldown changed from 30 seconds to 25 seconds, the Range will be increased by 20%， and the number of Combos increased

[b]Deadfall: [/b]Skill cooldown changed from 60 seconds to 45 seconds, the Range will be increased by 25%， and the number of Combos increased

[b]Blood sacrifice dance: [/b]Added a buff that increases physical attack by 10% in the additional effects

[b]Dragon Dance: [/b]and the range will be increased by 30%， and the coefficient of skill attack effect increased by 15%； at the same time, the effect of the skill book [Twice the Swords for Twice the Fun, by Sha Nyweide: Dragon Dance]is replaced with using skills instead, physical attack +2.5%/5%/7.5%/10%

[b]Fierce Lash: [/b]the number of Combos increased, and the coefficient of skill attacks will be increased by 20%

[b]Black Rose: [/b]and the number of Combos increased， and the coefficient of attack caused by the skill effect will be Increased by 30%

[b]Pirouette Strike: [/b]the number of Combos increased, the Range will be increased by 50%， and the coefficient of attack caused by the skill effect will be Increased by 30%. Enhance the effect of attracting monsters； at the same time, the effect of the skill book [Twice the Swords for Twice the Fun, by Sha Nyweide: Pirouette Strike] is replaced with using skills instead, physical attack +2.5%/5%/7.5%/10%

[b]B. Valkyrie/Cannon Angel[/b]

[b]Flamethrower: [/b]During skill introduction, reduce self-damage by 35% [PVP not available], and the coefficient of skill attacks will be increased by 20%

[b]Shooting Ray: [/b]During skill introduction, reduce self-damage by 50% [PVP not available]， and Skill cooldown changed from 50 seconds to 40 seconds， at the same time, the effect of the skill book [Celline Adele’s Bayonet Theory: Shooting Ray]is replaced with using skills instead, physical attack +2.5%/5%/7.5%/10%

[b]Gale Shot: [/b]During skill introduction, reduce self-damage by 50% [PVP not available]， at the same time, the effect of the skill book [Celline Adele’s Bayonet Theory: Gale Shot]is replaced with using skills instead, physical attack +2.5%/5%/7.5%/10%

[b]Anti-gravity Canon: [/b]Anti-gravity Canon: The added effect of increasing the defense of allies in the Anti-gravity Canon is changed to reducing the damage taken by allies by 30% and granting endure stats on allies for 10 seconds. At the same time, the increase in the monster attracting effect will be added and the number of electronic wave attack combos generated by the Light blue skill book [Celline Adele's Bayonet Theory: Anti-gravity Canon] will be increased.

[b]Gravity Cannon: [/b]In the gravity field, cause 30% physical defense to the target (new-added), decrease the magic defense, and increase the monster attracting effect of the gravity ball generated by the dark blue & light blue skill book [Celline Adele’s Bayonet Theory: Gravity Cannon], and increase the number of attack combos.

Multi-target Shoot: During the skill charging stage, reduce self-damage by 50% [PVP not available]

[b]Device Enchant:[/b] Skill cooldown reduced from 90 seconds to 60 seconds， and the duration will be increased from 40 to 60 seconds， Added a buff that increases physical attack by 10% in the additional effects

[b]Hawkeye: [/b]Within 5 seconds after the skill is cast, reduce self-damage by 80% [PVP not available]

[b]Laser Cannon: [/b]During the skill charging stage, reduce self-damage by 50% [PVP not available]， and skill damage increased by 35%/45%/60%/100% respectively

[b]Optimization: [/b]Login and Attendance Reward Optimization
[b]Optimization: [/b]Daily Login Reward Content Optimization
[b]Optimization: [/b]Attendance Reward 1 hr/2 hr/ hr Reward Chest Optimization

[b]New added: [/b]New Wings -Nepahi Symphony Butterfly

New added: New “Nepahi Symphony Butterfly Wings ”performance is greatly improved
Boost effect1- Wings Stats improve
Boost effect2- Wings Increase the damage effect of all classes' designated skills

notes.title: C9 Global 1st Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/1065e470655fe256888108fd7375d3b2602fa00e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Continent of the Ninth Seal 1st Anniversary[/b][/h1]

The time has come for us to commemorate the Continent of the Ninth Seal 1st Anniversary!
Make room and give way for the exciting and thrilling celebration of C9’s Anniversary!

The anniversary event will start this September 1, 2022. We will provide a variety of excitement events in line with C9’s first Anniversary. We would like to extend our deepest appreciation to you, our devoted players. Actionist around the world, Thank you so much!

[h2]1[b]st Anniversary Events[/b][/h2]

Prepare yourself for a whole month festivities including dungeon events, login rewards, giveaway and boost events! We will have a Daily Login Giveaway so make sure to login during September 1 – 21, 2022!

Be ready to face our event mobs across the continents as spawn chance has been greatly boosted. Starting September 1 – 30, 2022.

Celebrate with us for the goddesses have descended upon this world. In celebration of the coming of the Goddess of Malevolence there will be a 300% EXP Bonus Event on September 9, 10, & 11. Also the Goddess of Malevolence Boxes will be offered on the cash shop for only 50 Gcoin on those days. One might receive her grace or anguish.

After the Goddess of Malevolence presented her presence. The most awaited Holy Goddess will shower all the blessings we needed. The Holy Goddess will provide 700% EXP Bonus in the future!

[h3][b]Login Rewards[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/4cd9dd37bacf72291b9e2334e34f6400cffd226f.png[/img]

[h2][b]1st Anniversary SNS Event[/b][/h2]

We’ve been together through hard times and good times. As fellow Actionist, we want to hear your story. Let us reflect on our journey across the continent and this time, tell us more about your story from the beginning of playing C9. There will be valuable rewards to be won!

[h2][b]1st Anniversary Event Calendar[/b][/h2]

In celebration of C9 Global's 1st Year Anniversary under the VFUN Service, we'll be holding various events starting today until the end of September! Be sure to check out our Event Calendar! More will be revealed each week so stay tune.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/ec629b347c215eb5b65ed7ffc31d2bf55b6eef5c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Super-Secret Giveaway on September 29th![/b][/h2]

Be sure to login on [b]September 29, 2022[/b] for the super-secret giveaway as the item will only be given and received on that day only. You don’t want to miss on this chance!

September 28, 2022 PST
September 29, 2022 UTC
September 29, 2022 CET

[h2][b]Anniversary Exclusive Cash Shop Item[/b][/h2]

During this Anniversary, we'll be putting a C9 Anniversary Box on the cash shop for only 100 GCOINs. The random box will only be up on the cash shop for entire duration of the event.

C9 Anniversary Box Content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/f6c6d8f135f4bbed5803d166a3c3857bc8df8556.png[/img]

Stay tune as we still got more surprises for everyone!

Brave forth, as the search for the mysyical creature begins!

Promotion Period:

July 1 to July 31, 2022

Reward Insertion Period:

The next month's 1st/2nd Maintenance

Details:
1. Spend the minimum required GCOINS to reach a tier.
2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached, other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.
3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (eg. 29996 GC will be only eligible for the 20000 GC tier).

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/9d60d76863dea4224d507553103042cac4fc4a73.jpg[/img]

Amidst the continents exist an unchallenged dungeon
Its rumored to have valuable treasure within it
But beware, curious Actionist
as only those strong can reign and prove their supremacy


You will be be traversing unfamiliar and uncharted lands
The monsters will be vicious but you will be fierce

notes.title: Dungeon of Diligence
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/13ca382611c07c228c9ce3602ba9a42bdf7069d7.jpg[/img]

Greetings Actionists!

As the season of Spring ends, the season of Summer begins. As the new season fast approaches, a group of dust-like monsters called Gilings have awakened and will be roaming around dungeons across the continent. The monster has been known to come into multiple types and color and it’s a possibility that their color can be an indication of their strength. It’s been rumored such monsters carries important treasures that may be worthy to any adventurers seeking for valuable items. The hunt is on adventurers.

[b][Seasonal Event Duration][/b]

April 28, 2022 ~ May 11, 2022

[b][Event Mechanics][/b]

Enter the Dungeons from the 3rd-8th Continent on Expert or Master difficulty to randomly encounter the [b][Giling][/b], [b][Giling King][/b], [b][Bronze Giling][/b],[b] [Silver Giling][/b], and or [b][Golden Giling] [/b]event monster. Get a chance to get [Proof of Diligence Box] every time you defeat any of the event monster.

notes.title: 2022 Spring Dungeon Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/5cec3fde3c660da1817ac2a6b0631ff8b11f7517.jpg[/img]

Greetings Actionists!

As the snowy stasis that binds begins to subside, it starts to bloom and blossom once more! Spring is here! Unfortunately, the ill-natured Spring Rabbits have appeared across the continents and they may randomly appear and attack any unlucky adventurers that they see. But for daring adventurers like you, this may be an opportunity to make a name for yourself.

Defeat the Spring Rabbit event monster for a chance of getting a limited-time event reward!

[b][Event Duration][/b]

March 3, 2022 ~ March 17, 2022

[b][Event Mechanics][/b]

Enter the Dungeons from the 3rd-8th Continent on Expert or Master difficulty to randomly encounter the [Spring Rabbit] event monster. Get a chance to get [Egg Hidden by Rabbit] every time you defeat a [Spring Rabbit] event monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/596da5975538afc5fa67329a2a6bd6e863675238.png[/img]
[b]Spring Rabbit[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/33d922365ab59c9516819a9798ae44d0f9ce2378.png[/img]

Login daily to claim 10 Judar Exorcism Expendable Spellstone Chest!

Open a [Egg Hidden by Rabbit] for a variety of random goods including hats, rabbit ears, horns, and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/653c3dc003f2ddf8f00ccc3b7bafab4d637e72c3.png[/img]

Jump for joy, spring forth, and seize the day!

notes.title: Sky Dragon Weapon Hoard!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4064799/6d78ed71ab2bf4e66b0866da264a852e455e10a6.jpg[/img]

As the sky dragon ascend, he left a treasure for everyone to desire, such treasure will bring prosperity and power that no one can procure. However, in order to acclaimed the said treasure a huge amount of luck and perseverance an individual should have.

Stand forth, as we bring the sky dragon weapon hoard to everyone!

[b]Promotion Period:[/b]
March 1 to March 31, 2022

[b]Reward Insertion Period:[/b]
The next month's 1st/2nd Maintenance

[b]Details:[/b]
1. Spend the minimum required GCOINS to reach a tier.
2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached, other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.
3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (eg. 29996 GC will be only eligible for the 20000 GC tier).
4. After the promotion period, the rewards will be inserted directly on the player's storage on the 1st or 2nd Maintenance of the next month.

[b]Note:[/b] Bonus GCOINS will not be included in the total GCOINS spent.

notes.title: Service Transition Announcement
notes.content:
Hello C9 Community!

It is never easy to make an announcement like this to a community, especially when it’s one that’s been as dedicated and helpful as you have for such a long time.

However, after numerous talks with all the teams involved with the C9 project, it is with a heavy heart that we announce C9 will no longer be serviced by Webzen and will instead be transferred to a new publishing partner, VALOFE on VFUN. A detailed date of transition will be announced later.

We are working with VALOFE to ensure there is a smooth transition between companies, with the priority being as little impact to yourselves as possible. You shall be able to transfer your characters over to new publisher during transfer period. We are aiming to start the transition on September 14th. (Schedule is subject to delay from target date). 

To keep things short, we just want to thank everyone for their continued support throughout the years - it was truly you, the community, who made the game what it is today.

That said, things are not going to stop right away, and we shall continue to offer you the best support and experience that we can until the handover.
Again, thank you to our community for being awesome and supportive.
Best,

[b]Please notice that your wcoin will not be transfer to VFUN. We would like to recommend spending your wcoin before the transition day. [/b]



Service Transition Plan from VFUN,

[previewyoutube=KNt1LeXFqhg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










New updates are coming, and C9 will be migrating to VFUN! But have no worry! There’s no need to reinstall your current game client. On <Insert Target Date>, Just update the game client through patch and you’re good to go! You must also create a VFUN account, this account will be used as a container for your transferred account from Webzen, it’s as easy as that! 

And to make your VFUN experience VeryFUN, we will be giving away gifts and goodies to players who will complete their migration!

You will also receive the following items:
- Goddess' Tears x1000
- Mysterious Egg
- Event Charm Chest [STR] [7 days]
- Sleeping Warrior's Soul: Mana Crafter
- Joker II

You can also check C9 news on VFUN Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/C9.VFUN/ 
We’re excited to see you all on our new home and meet new players and have new adventures await you. See you C9 actionists!!
VALOFE C9 Team

notes.title: New Free to Play - Continent of the Ninth Seal
notes.content:
Continent of the Ninth Seal is now available on Steam and is Free to Play!

Stand together as heroes of Glenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion. Continent of the Ninth Seal (C9) showcases quality visuals, strategic combat, and a gripping story. Choose a character that best represents how you want to experience the game. The four base classes -- Fighter, Hunter, Shaman, and Witchblade -- can each upgrade into multiple advanced classes, all of which are unique in their skills, visuals, and play styles. The console-like controls, various skill combos, and RPG-based elements, make C9 a satisfying choice for all fans of action games.

Steam users can also now grab the Continent of the Ninth Seal: Starter Pack and get a head start on the competition! Purchase before September 20th at 10AM Pacific time and receive 50% off!
